summary: Added create-view and drop-view actions to the permission system so execute-write SQL supports CREATE VIEW and DROP VIEW. (1) default_actions.py: registered the two new Actions. (2) write_sql.py: added decision cases in decision_for_write_sql_operation for create/view (requires create-view on the database) and drop/view (requires drop-view on the view as TableResource). (3) sql_analysis.py: renamed dropped_tables to dropped_tables_and_views and extended it to include drop/view keys so the spurious SQLite delete on a dropped view name does not create a delete-row requirement. (4) docs/authentication.rst: updated the --root permission list and added create-view/drop-view action sections. All 90 tests in tests/test_queries.py pass.
concerns: The drop-view test (test_execute_write_schema_operations_use_schema_permissions with id drop-view) was already written and passes; confirm the drop-view permission is correctly scoped to the specific
